annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/1058 of 27 April 2020 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 as regards the introduction of two new unmanned aircraft systems classes
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2020/1058 of 27 April 2020 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 as regards the introduction of two new unmanned aircraft systems classes
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 232/1
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Delegated Regulation amending 2019/945 to add UAS classes C5 and C6 for standard-scenario operations, require remote identification for specific-category UAS, and set product requirements, CE marking, conformity assessment modules and technical documentation for drones placed on the EU market.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates new UAS classes C5 (with C3 conversion accessories kits) and C6 with specific technical requirements
Requires remote identification and unique serial numbers for UAS in the specific category
Manufacturers must perform conformity assessment, CE marking, EU declaration of conformity and class labels
Certification required for UAS above defined risk thresholds such as transporting people
Sets noise limits and sound power labelling by class; C5/C6 makers must inform market surveillance authority
